title: Hero Trinity
description: A structural hero with a localized introduction, responsive media, and an optional primary and secondary CTA group.

theme.description: CMS-selected presentation setting passed to the renderer.

ctas.description: Optional CTA group with an optional primary CTA and an optional secondary CTA.

image.description: Editor-selected, per-locale desktop hero media; the renderer fills the design container using cover.

mobileImage.description: Optional editor-selected, per-locale mobile hero media; the renderer fills the design container using cover.
